approved.en: Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy facilities, including a strike that killed 17 in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. President Trump announced an alleged Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire linked to a diesel deal, prompting Ukraine to call the claim false after further strikes. The Houthi movement launched a second missile attack on Riyadh airport, killing a Pakistani national and wounding several people, leading Saudi Arabia to extend airport suspensions. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland fortsetter luftangrep på ukrainske energianlegg, inkludert et angrep som drepte 17 i Zaporizjzja, mens Ukraina sier at de vil pause sine egne raffineriangrep dersom Russland stopper sine energiangrep. President Trump kunngjorde et påstått Russland-Ukraina energivåpenhvile knyttet til en dieselforhandling, noe som fikk Ukraina til å erklære påstanden falsk etter ytterligere angrep. Houthiene lanserte et andre missilangrep mot Riyadh flyplass, der en pakistansk nasjonal ble drept og flere personer ble såret, noe som førte til at Saudi-Arabia forlenget suspensjonen av flyplassen. 75 767 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Israeli Defence Forces have declared a permanent presence in depopulated West Bank camps while establishing polling stations in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria ahead of elections. Israel has approved a U.S. firm to identify sites for handing over Hamas arms and is cooperating with the Board of Peace on demilitarisation of Gaza. Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks, and Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israel har godkjent et amerikansk firma til å identifisere steder for overlevering av Hamas-våpen og samarbeider med Peace Board om demilitarisering av Gaza. Forsvarsminister Herzog sier at en større politistyrke er nødvendig for å dempe voldskriminalitet og bosetterangrep, og israelske etterretningssoldater har avdekket et politisk skifte som rettferdiggjør sivile tap i Gaza. Konflikten forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives were seized in two trucks at Lebanese checkpoints, prompting Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to vow thorough investigations. In northern Israel, a teenager was killed and dozens wounded when a Hezbollah submunition exploded in his backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes in the area. Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. The conflict has produced 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel ble en tenåring drept og dusinvis såret da en Hezbollah-submunisjon eksploderte i ryggsekken hans under en fottur nær Libanons grense, noe som førte til at IDF-sjefen beordret en undersøkelse og myndighetene vurderte å begrense fotturer i området. Israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter mot Hezbollah-posisjoner i Sør-Libanon, og forårsaker sivile tap. Konflikten har ført til 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi missiles have struck Riyadh airport repeatedly, killing twelve and wounding many, prompting Saudi Arabia to extend the airport suspension and vow a deadly response. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards are identified as the likely source of threats against RAF Fairford and are reported to have targeted a US-UAE oil shuttle in the Strait of Hormuz. An oil tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz region and the IRGC responded to a supertanker mine strike, extending combat into Iranian waters. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Irans revolusjonsgarden er identifisert som sannsynlig kilde til trusler mot RAF Fairford og skal ha rettet seg mot en US-UAE oljetog i Hormuzstredet. Et oljetanker ble angrepet i Hormuzstredet, og IRGC svarte på et supertankermineangrep, og utvidet kampene til iranske farvann. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

At the same time a migrant boat from Djibouti to Yemen capsized, killing 139 people, including children. Iran’s foreign minister called the Saudi Crown Prince to urge diplomatic solutions while Iran-backed militants continue pressure on the Crown Prince. The conflict produced 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Samtidig kantret en migrantbåt fra Djibouti til Jemen, og 139 personer, inkludert barn, omkom. Irans utenriksminister ringte den saudiske kronprinsen for å oppfordre til diplomatiske løsninger mens Iran-støttede militante fortsetter presset på kronprinsen. Konflikten førte til 918 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Syrian security forces stepped up anti-ISIS operations, pursued former regime loyalists, and clashed with private security firms linked to a new Syrian security mogul, while also foiling drug-smuggling attempts on the Iraq and Jordan borders. Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker intensiverte anti-IS-operasjoner, forfulgte tidligere regimelojalister og kom i konflikt med private sikkerhetsfirmaer knyttet til en ny syrisk sikkerhetsmogul, samtidig som de avverget narkotikasmuglingsforsøk på grensen til Irak og Jordan. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: PKK militants have withdrawn from four camps in northern Iraq, including Metina, as part of a peace process with Turkey, while Iranian drones struck a Kurdish opposition camp in the same region. Iraqi fighter jets have destroyed a Daesh position in an eastern province, and US envoy Tom Barrack met Iraqi judge Faiq Zaidan in Baghdad to discuss economic partnership and security cooperation. Four drug traffickers were sentenced in Dhi Qar and a meeting praised Al-Zaidi after a productive discussion in Baghdad. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iraks jagerfly har ødelagt en IS-posisjon i en østlig provins, og USAs representant Tom Barrack møtte den irakiske dommeren Faiq Zaidan i Bagdad for å diskutere økonomisk partnerskap og sikkerhetssamarbeid. approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have carried out air strikes on gold mining sites on the Sudan-Egypt border, killing dozens of miners. The Rapid Support Forces have used a paramilitary drone to strike near the Ethiopian frontier, causing additional casualties. These attacks extend fighting into civilian mining areas and the border triangle region, threatening civilians in West Kordofan. The war has already produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Disse angrepene utvider kampene til sivile gruveområder og trekantregionen ved grensen, og truer sivilbefolkningen i Vest-Kordofan. Krigen har allerede forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the two battle-related deaths recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have used drones to strike Eritrean troops that were backing Tigrayan rebels, while Eritrean soldiers have crossed into Ethiopian territory, prompting both sides to request UN deterrence or intervention. Ethiopian troops have moved into Adigrat in Tigray near the Eritrean border, and Ethiopia says it is acting in self-defence against Eritrean actions. Eritrea has called on the UN to intervene in the standoff and to take deterrence measures against Ethiopia. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Etiopiske tropper har beveget seg inn i Adigrat i Tigray nær grensen mot Eritrea, og Etiopia sier de handler i selvforsvar mot eritreiske handlinger. Eritrea har oppfordret FN til å gripe inn i fastlåst situasjon og iverksette avskrekkende tiltak mot Etiopia. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Government forces are massing near opposition leaders' homes while rival groups have seized three towns in southern and central Somalia, expanding the fighting. A UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, and US agents are searching Ilhan Omar's home in a criminal investigation. Pakistani sailors freed from Somali pirates are returning home, and a market shooting in Garowe killed two and wounded four. Somali authorities are screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case, and the UN has issued an urgent appeal to protect civilians in Baidoa. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Pakistanske sjøfolk som ble frigjort fra somaliske pirater, vender hjem, og en skyting på et marked i Garowe drepte to og såret fire. Somaliske myndigheter screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og FN har sendt en hastesøknad om å beskytte sivile i Baidoa. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Fulani militants hacked 12 Christians to death in Benue and killed additional civilians in Plateau and Niger, while bandits killed an immigration officer and burned his body in Niger. Ansaru terrorists planned an attack on a school in Oyo, and Islamic terrorists assaulted three villages in northeast Nigeria. Russian fighters and the Malian army retook the strategic northern town of Kidal after separatists withdrew. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russiske styrker og den maliske hæren tok den strategiske nordlige byen Kidal tilbake etter at separatistene trakk seg tilbake. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
